title: When the Honest Answer Is 'Only a Little'

scenes.line1: What if you only know a little?
scenes.say: Ever get asked about something you barely touched? Here's how to handle it honestly and stand out.

scenes.label: Honesty
scenes.sub: Say what you've done, what you haven't, and your approach.
scenes.say: First, say what you have done, what you haven't, and how you would tackle it if given the chance.

rows.b: I'd break it down, ask for context, and design a plan

scenes.say: For example: I've worked alongside the system. I haven't owned it end to end. But I'd break it down, ask for context, and design a plan.

scenes.question: Should you bluff if you know only a little?
scenes.wrong: Yes, fake it till you make it.
scenes.right: No. Bluffing gets caught fast. Honest reasoning scores better.
scenes.say: Don't bluff. Interviewers spot it quick and follow up. Honest reasoning shows self-awareness and earns respect.
